messages:
samir: Quick one — customer sent a security questionnaire, due EOD. First Q: do our logs ever contain PII (headers, user email, raw user_id)?

tanvi: Short answer: we don't keep raw auth headers or emails. We redact auth headers/cookies and we HMAC user IDs before writing request logs. I'll paste the exact config in a sec.

morgan: +1. The redaction runs in the ingest pipeline (pre-index). Patterns we remove: Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, X-Api-Key, password, email addresses. Any user-visible id is HMACed with a service-wide key.

tanvi: Config snippet:
```
redact_patterns:
  - Authorization
  - Cookie
  - Set-Cookie
  - X-API-Key
  - email
replacement: "[REDACTED]"
hmac_user_id: true
hmac_algo: HMAC-SHA256
```

liz: For the questionnaire wording: say "PII is not stored in plaintext in logs; auth tokens and cookies are redacted; user identifiers are irreversible HMACs." Also mention retention policy (30 days for request logs, 90 for aggregate metrics).

samir: Good. Next Q: encryption and key management — what's our official phrasing?

morgan: TLS 1.2+ for transport. At rest we use cloud provider encryption with customer-managed keys for Private deployments (KMS/HSM). Hosted uses provider-managed CMKs but keys are rotated regularly and audited.

tanvi: Add that database backups are encrypted (AES-256) and S3/GCS buckets have bucket-level encryption with SSE-KMS when applicable.

samir: Subprocessors list — what do we disclose? Customer expects GCP, Datadog, Sentry/Rollbar, Auth0? We don't use Auth0 though.

liz: Current subprocessors: GCP (Compute, GCS, BigQuery), AWS (S3 for cross-region backups), Datadog (metrics/traces), Sentry (error reporting), Fastly/CDN, Segment for analytics (opt-in). We should be explicit about purpose and region. Don't forget the hosted infra partner for Private customers (vendor name redacted until NDA).

ops-bot: Reminder: vendor access and subprocessors changes require a vendor-access request in #vendor-access and a @security sign-off. See process link: https://confluence/repo/vendor-access

tanvi: Who can approve temporary access for compliance scans? Usually an on-call SRE + @security-team lead or delegated approver. We have the approval matrix in the playbook.

samir: SOC2/ISO status — how to answer? Customer asks if we're certified and for the report.

morgan: We have SOC2 Type II report available for customers under NDA via the compliance portal. ISO27001 certification is in progress for the hosted scope — say "in progress" if asked.

liz: I'll attach the compliance portal link and note the process to request reports. Also mention regular pen tests and internal audits.

samir: Great. I'll draft the questionnaire answers with those bullets. Can someone quick-review before I send?

liz: Send draft here, happy to review.

tanvi: I can check the logging/config bits.

security-bot: Template for SEC questionnaire responses: https://confluence/security/sec-qa-template — use the "logs & encryption" section.

samir: Thanks all — will post draft in 30m. :thumbsup:
